    $xPlatform231 = 3.5;

function platformDefaults231(int &$first, int &$digits = PHP_FLOAT_DIG, int $epsilonUnit = (int)(PHP_FLOAT_EPSILON * 4503599627370496), int $minimumUnit = (int)(PHP_FLOAT_MIN * PHP_FLOAT_MAX)) {
    echo 'body:', $first, ':', $digits, ':', $epsilonUnit, ':', $minimumUnit, '|';
    $digits = 9;
    $first = $first + 1;
}
set_error_handler('platformWarning231');

echo 'cold:x=', $xPlatform231, '|';
$xPlatform231 = 1.5;
platformDefaults231($xPlatform231);
echo 'warm:x=', $xPlatform231, '|';
